newsitem.title: CHINA: Economy of China's Shenzhen grows 16.5 pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Economy of China's Shenzhen grows 16.5 pct in H1.

text.p: The economy of China's booming southern special economic zone of Shenzhen grew by a year-on-year 16.5 percent in the first half of the year, to 46.3 billion yuan, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The city's fiscal revenue in the first six months surged 33.4 percent from a year ago to more than 6.9 billion yuan, or 55.9 percent of the budgeted figure for the year, it said.
With fiscal revenue growing at a rate twice that of gross domestic product, the revenue as a proportion of GDP had risen to 14.6 percent by June, markedly higher than the national average, it said.
